controls.input: Untouched preparation and complete pinned Git inputs
controls.expect: Authenticated preparation; admitted=false; all29 HELD. Exit zero is not semantic success.

controls.input: Exact74 author names without authenticated root HTML74 acceptance, or the unaccepted streaming repair
controls.expect: HOLD; no DU invocation, even if pack reproduction succeeds.

controls.input: Old mode committed-archive, transient mode relabel, or full-history claim
controls.expect: Reject this addendum's binding; never dispatch the original validator using a forged mode.

controls.input: Changed, removed, extra, duplicate, traversal, symlink or other nonregular selected input; changed mode/blob/hash; later source/helper
controls.expect: Reject before materialization/execution; do not repair using live source. Each mutation is an isolated control.

controls.input: Absent pinned pack, partial census, one changed nonloaded member, matching emitted JS but differing tar bytes, or failed reproduction
controls.expect: No admission; require direct whole-pack byte equality, exact SHA-256 and complete package census.

controls.input: Missing original required binding/root approval, unauthorized supervisor/tool, changed helper/dependency, unspecified write isolation or new protected-tree entry
controls.expect: Reject; preserve original common requirements and pre/post authentication, including new entries.

controls.input: Accepted HTML74, all authentic root bindings, complete pinned inputs/tools and exact independently reproduced full pack
controls.expect: Eligible for a separately reviewed future admission implementation only; v1 still refuses admission. No DU29 result follows from eligibility.

controls.input: Unrelated live worktree edits or foreign staging while pinned committed inputs remain identical
controls.expect: Do not veto scoped input authentication or consume those live bytes; do not require global index equality.

controls.input: Missing explicit root/subpath export; source fallback; absent/tampered load proof; mismatched consumer/helper; symlink install; old move location remains
controls.expect: Reject before semantic credit; original P03-P06/R03 guards remain required.

controls.input: Count74, count76, duplicate75 or substituted75, even if names look plausible
controls.expect: Reject exact root-approved75 comparison; keep getopts builtin, HTML present and curl/SafeJS/expr excluded.

controls.input: Admitted exact pack physically installed/moved, authenticated complete actual-load evidence and strict declaration controls, then all29 separately executable cases
controls.expect: Report each actual result against original frozen assertions, without converting blocked cases or expected guard failures into semantic passes.
